name: UniFi-API-Browser
description: The API Browser lets you pull raw, JSON formatted data from the API running on your UniFi Controller. **Connecting to Multiple UniFi Controllers:** Unifi-API-Browser supports multiple controllers. To use them create a copy of 'users-tempalte.php' and 'config-template.php' and mount them as volumes at '/app/config/config.php' & '/app/config/users.php'

variables.name: UniFi Controller Username
variables.description: the user name for access to the Unifi Controller. NOTE: use a 'Local Access' account, not a 'Ubiquiti Account'.

variables.name: UniFi Controller Password
variables.description: the password for access to the Unifi Controller

variables.name: UniFi Controller IP
variables.description: IP address of the Unifi Controller

variables.name: UniFi Controller Port
variables.description: Port if you changed the port UniFi is running on

variables.name: UniFi Controller Name
variables.description: name for this controller which will be used in the dropdown menu

variables.name: Enable Debug Logging
variables.description: set to 'true' (without quotes) to enable debug output to the browser and the PHP error log when fetching the sites collection after selecting a controller

variables.name: UI Auth Username
variables.description: username to secure the API Browser instance

variables.name: UI Auth Password
variables.description: Generate a SHA512 of the password you want and put here, you can use a tool like https://sha512.online/ by default the password is 'admin'

variables.name: UI Theme
variables.description: your default theme of choice, pick one from the following list: bootstrap, cerulean, cosmo, cyborg, darkly, flatly, journal, lumen, paper readable, sandstone, simplex, slate, spacelab, superhero, united, yeti

variables.name: UI Navbar Class
variables.description: class for the main navigation bar, valid options are: light, dark

variables.name: UI Navbar Background Class
variables.description: class for the main navigation bar background, valid options are: primary, secondary, success, danger, warning, info, light, dark, white, transparent
